m: Cut the pork into 3cm cubes. Toss with the oregano, juice of half the lemons, half the garlic, a glug of oil and 1 tsp salt. Leave 20 minutes, then thread onto skewers if you have them.
Chips: heat oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into wedges, toss with oil and salt, roast 35 to 40 minutes, turning once.
Tzatziki: grate half the cucumber, squeeze out the water, and stir into the yoghurt with the rest of the garlic, chopped mint, lemon and salt.
Greek salad: chop the rest of the cucumber, the tomatoes and red onion, crumble over the fetta, dress with oil and lemon.
Grill pan or BBQ the pork 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Warm the pita. Everyone builds their own.
l: Pack pork, salad and tzatziki separately. Skip the chips and double the salad.
g: GF wraps instead of pita. Everything else is naturally gluten free.
